narrow-component-role.description: Rust requires an explicit component role before component-context macros are legal; indirect or anonymous owners fail closed.
narrow-component-role.migrationAction: Move component-context macros into a directly declared component or hook owner.
narrow-component-role.removalCondition: Revisit only through an explicit future component-ownership design; Babel-style implicit owner inference is not a 0.32 parity target.

structured-hook-return.description: Rust enforces readonly and setter rules for structured same-module hook return accessors.
structured-hook-return.migrationAction: Keep mutation inside the hook or expose and call an explicit supported setter.
structured-hook-return.removalCondition: Revisit only if the public hook-return contract gains a new binding-safe writable accessor representation.

standard-decorator-fail-closed.description: Rust rejects standard decorators until a target-compatible transform can produce runnable JavaScript.
standard-decorator-fail-closed.migrationAction: Run a target-compatible decorator transform before native Fict compilation, or remove the decorators.
standard-decorator-fail-closed.removalCondition: Remove only if native decorator lowering is implemented with an executable target-runtime oracle.

strict-reactivity-fail-closed.description: Rust strictGuarantee rejects reactive control-flow region fallback instead of silently accepting output that requires R006 re-execution.
strict-reactivity-fail-closed.migrationAction: Refactor to a guaranteed expression branch, or explicitly opt into the reviewed non-strict R006 fallback outside production.
strict-reactivity-fail-closed.removalCondition: Remove only when the affected statement control flow gains a proven fine-grained lowering; strict mode must not silently adopt fallback semantics.
